name: table-30
description: Tabs above a table filter invoices by status with counts.

"use client" import * as React from "react" import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow, } from "@workspace/ui/components/table" import { Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from "@workspace/ui/components/tabs" import { cn } from "@workspace/ui/lib/utils" const invoices = [ { id: "INV-2041", client: "Brand identity", amount: 1200, status: "Paid" }, { id: "INV-2042", client: "UI/UX audit", amount: 860, status: "Overdue", }, { id: "INV-2043", client: "Design system", amount: 450, status: "Draft" }, { id: "INV-2044", client: "Next.js website", amount: 2300, status: "Paid" }, { id: "INV-2045", client: "CGI & motion reel", amount: 310, status: "Overdue" }, ] const filters = ["All", "Paid", "Overdue", "Draft"] export default function StatusFilterTabsTable() { const [filter, setFilter] = React.useState("All") const rows = filter === "All" ? invoices : invoices.filter((i) => i.status === filter) return (
setFilter(v as string)}> {filters.map((f) => ( {f} {f === "All" ? invoices.length : invoices.filter((i) => i.status === f).length} ))}
Invoice Project Amount {rows.map((inv) => ( {inv.id} {inv.client} {"$" + inv.amount.toLocaleString()} ))}
) }
